description: This file defines a REST API controller for importing various system data entities into a database. It handles JSON file uploads, deserialization, and batch insertion of entities like users, projects, tasks, and others into the database, with error handling and response aggregation.

classes.name: SystemDataImportController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for importing system data from JSON files into the database.

classes.name: ImportResponse
classes.description: Internal class representing the overall response of the import operation, including errors and results.

classes.name: ImportEntityResult
classes.description: Internal class representing the result of importing a single entity type, including the number of entities imported and errors.

methods.name: ImportData
methods.description: HTTP POST endpoint to accept a JSON file, deserialize it into entities, and insert into the database with error reporting.

methods.name: ImportEntity
methods.description: Handles the import of a specific entity type based on the entity name, calling the appropriate DbSet.

methods.name: ImportAsync
methods.description: Generic method to deserialize a JSON array into entities and add them to the DbSet.

methods.name: GetRootExceptionMessage
methods.description: Extracts the innermost message from an exception.
